Activity 5 - Independently assess represented account coverage.
Look for: Read original advocate evidence before comparing the current records,
held or outside-owned proposals and operations that can actually be admitted.
Existing records are NM interpretations to compare with that evidence, never
their own authority. Rejected, unassessed or dependency-unavailable proposals
cannot count as represented merely because they were submitted. An already
faithful current record may cover content without a new row. Review can
legitimately require no changes and no fresh factual assertion.
Outcome: Include coverage with state complete, partial or unassessed; a concise
reason identifying the substantive judgment; and missing_source_ids selected
only from coverage_source_ids. Complete means no materially missing content or
needed reconciliation was found in this scope and requires an empty missing list.
Partial means relevant content or reconciliation remains missing: explain the
missing proposition or distinction and select owned original source IDs when
the gap can be localized. The missing list may be empty when it cannot. Unassessed means this
coverage could not be dependably decided; missing IDs may be empty when no gap
can be localized. A source span may contain several propositions; selecting it
is not proof that every proposition is represented. Do not require a new record
or force complete. Return coverage even for verdicts=[] on an authorised empty
or coverage-only review. On correction, return verdicts only for the listed
pending candidates plus coverage; preserve settled peers and full source context.
A valid partial or unassessed assessment is a legitimate result, not an error
that must be repaired into complete.

call_accounting.normal_formula: N = 3 + 5*m + Bq + Br + Bv + Be, before local correction/opening repair/narrowed-response review.

definitions.3: One interpretation + one batched response writer + one independent response Judge for a normal successful nonempty message, including greetings.
definitions.m: 1 when plan.material_review or opening.ready selects reading. Five calls: candidate-free source classification, dispute extraction, dispute Judge, detail extraction, detail/opening Judge. Exact review_scope activates both Judges even for zero proposals.
definitions.Bq: Context-fitting due research query-planning batches; zero when no due subject or current owned evidence is reusable.
definitions.Br: Context-fitting reader batches with actual supplied passages; no passages => zero reader calls.
definitions.Bv: Context-fitting nonempty finding Judge batches; scoped supplied-pool coverage shares these calls.
definitions.Be: Context-fitting empty-reading Judge batches for zero findings after actual supplied passages. No supplied passages => no empty Judge; state is a code-owned scoped receipt.

limits: Repair-free context-fitting successful examples are not a fixed cost or global maximum. Some valid output can be retained after partial failures.
Each checked_read and each record Judge invocation allows at most two attempts; candidate/coverage correction stays local and retains independently checked peers.
Research groups are preflighted with complete context and can split. Full-pool input may change batching; oversize or unread coverage cannot erase valid narrower cited-source findings.
An independently rejected opening can trigger checked repair_opening and independent alternative checks. Exhausted unread O1 does not enter that branch.

Writer has two generation attempts; each response review invocation has two attempts. A separately narrowed subset may receive an additional response review; there is no global two-call response-recovery bound.
Code IDs, projections, snapshots, typed effect ownership gates, supplied-passage ownership, local search/rerank, work seals, commit and replay add no generative model calls.
Source/Judge separation is role independence, not model diversity. Actual service call receipts count model invocations; provider retries remain a separate metric.

Whole-account completion and supplied-passage coverage are independent model assessments: code validates owned scope/IDs/receipts, not semantic completeness of free prose or completeness of the corpus/search.
